```{r config}
data_path <- "mortality_health_analysis_readydata.rds"
if (!file.exists(data_path)) stop("Input file not found: ",data_path)
analysis_ready_matrix <- readRDS(data_path)
EXPOSURE_VAR <- "utci_mean"; OUTCOME_VAR <- "outcome"; STRATUM_VAR <- "stratum_id"; LAG_PREFIX <- "utci_lag"
if (!all(c(EXPOSURE_VAR,OUTCOME_VAR,STRATUM_VAR,"centreid","date","year","is_tier1","is_tier2") %in% names(analysis_ready_matrix))) stop("Required analysis variables are missing from the input data.")
analysis_ready_matrix <- analysis_ready_matrix %>% mutate(date=as.Date(date), year=year(date), month=month(date))
centre_lookup <- tibble(centreid=c("BF021","BF031","BF041","CI011","GH011","GH021","GH031","GM011","NG011","SN011","SN012","SN013"),centre_name=c("Nanoro","Nouna","Ouagadougou","Taabo","Navrongo","Kintampo","Dodowa","Farafenni","Nahuche","Bandafassi","Mlomp","Niakhar"),country=c("Burkina Faso","Burkina Faso","Burkina Faso","Côte d'Ivoire","Ghana","Ghana","Ghana","The Gambia","Nigeria","Senegal","Senegal","Senegal"),climate_zone=c("Sudano-Sahelian","Sudano-Sahelian","Sudano-Sahelian","Forest","Guinea Savannah","Forest-Savannah Transition","Coastal Savannah","Sudano-Sahelian","Sudano-Sahelian","Sudano-Sahelian","Guinea Savannah","Guinea Savannah")) %>% mutate(centre_label=paste0(centre_name," (",country,")"))
analysis_ready_matrix <- analysis_ready_matrix %>% select(-any_of(c("centre_name","country","climate_zone","centre_label"))) %>% left_join(centre_lookup,by="centreid")
KAPPA_MAX <- 500; DISPERSION_MAX <- 1.20; MIN_CENTRE_DEATHS <- 100; MMT_SEARCH_RANGE <- c(.01,.99)
tier_coverage <- bind_rows(lapply(c("Tier 1","Tier 2"),function(tn){ flag <- if(tn=="Tier 1") "is_tier1" else "is_tier2"; x <- analysis_ready_matrix %>% filter(.data[[flag]]==1); tibble(tier=tn,start_year=min(x$year,na.rm=TRUE),end_year=max(x$year,na.rm=TRUE),n_years=n_distinct(x$year),n_centres=n_distinct(x$centreid),observations=nrow(x),deaths=sum(x[[OUTCOME_VAR]]==1,na.rm=TRUE)) }))
PRIMARY_TIER <- tier_coverage$tier[order(-tier_coverage$n_years,-tier_coverage$observations)][1]
PRIMARY_TIER_FLAG <- if(PRIMARY_TIER=="Tier 1") "is_tier1" else "is_tier2"
dat <- analysis_ready_matrix %>% filter(.data[[PRIMARY_TIER_FLAG]]==1)
if(!"age_group"%in%names(dat)&&"age_at_death"%in%names(dat)) dat$age_group<-cut(dat$age_at_death,breaks=c(-Inf,5,65,Inf),labels=c("<5 years","5–64 years","65+ years"),right=FALSE)
tier1_audit <- dat %>% summarise(years=paste(min(year,na.rm=TRUE),max(year,na.rm=TRUE),sep="–"),n_centres=n_distinct(centreid),observations=n(),deaths=sum(.data[[OUTCOME_VAR]]==1,na.rm=TRUE))
```

# Section 0. Shared helper functions

Every model fit, diagnostic, and plot in this document goes through exactly one of these functions.

```{r helpers-fit}
build_lag_basis <- function(max_lag,lag_df=NULL,lag_knots=NULL){if(!is.null(lag_knots)) return(list(fun="ns",knots=lag_knots)); if(!is.null(lag_df)) return(list(fun="ns",df=lag_df)); if(max_lag<=3) return(list(fun="integer")); list(fun="ns",df=3)}
compute_qaic <- function(fit){phi<-summary(fit)$dispersion; ll<-sum(dpois(fit$y,fit$fitted.values,log=TRUE)); -2*ll+2*length(coef(fit))*phi}
compute_model_metrics <- function(fit,cb,MMT,max_lag,exposure_df,lag_df,max_RR=NA_real_){r<-qr(cb)$rank;tibble(max_lag=max_lag,exposure_df=exposure_df,lag_df=lag_df,converged=isTRUE(fit$converged),dispersion=summary(fit)$dispersion,QAIC=compute_qaic(fit),logLik=sum(dpois(fit$y,fit$fitted.values,log=TRUE)),rank=r,n_basis=ncol(cb),full_rank=r==ncol(cb),kappa=tryCatch(kappa(cb),error=function(e) NA_real_),MMT=round(MMT,2),max_RR=round(max_RR,1))}
cb_coef_vcov <- function(cb,fit){cn<-colnames(cb); b<-coef(fit); V<-vcov(fit); n<-ncol(cb); if(length(b)==n){idx<-seq_len(n)} else {idx<-match(cn,names(b)); if(anyNA(idx)){hits<-vapply(cn,function(z){w<-grep(paste0("(^|[.:])",gsub("\\.","\\\\.",z),"$"),names(b)); if(length(w)==1) w else NA_integer_},integer(1)); idx<-hits}}; if(length(idx)!=n||anyNA(idx)) stop("Unable to identify all crossbasis coefficients."); beta<-b[idx]; Vcb<-V[idx,idx,drop=FALSE]; names(beta)<-cn; rownames(Vcb)<-colnames(Vcb)<-cn; list(coef=beta,vcov=(Vcb+t(Vcb))/2)}
crosspred_aligned <- function(cb,fit,cen=NULL,by=.1,at=NULL){a<-cb_coef_vcov(cb,fit); args<-list(basis=cb,coef=a$coef,vcov=a$vcov,model.link="log",by=by); if(!is.null(cen)) args$cen<-cen; if(!is.null(at)) args$at<-at; do.call(dlnm::crosspred,args)}
run_dlnm_spec <- function(data,max_lag,exposure_df=3,lag_df=3,var_knots=NULL,lag_knots=NULL,exposure_var=EXPOSURE_VAR,outcome_var=OUTCOME_VAR,stratum_var=STRATUM_VAR,lag_prefix=LAG_PREFIX,cen=NULL,by=.1,quiet=TRUE){lag_cols<-paste0(lag_prefix,0:max_lag); miss<-setdiff(lag_cols,names(data)); if(length(miss)) return(NULL); lm<-as.matrix(data[,lag_cols]); keep<-complete.cases(lm); d<-data[keep,,drop=FALSE]; lm<-lm[keep,,drop=FALSE]; if(!nrow(d)) return(NULL); if(is.null(var_knots)) var_knots<-equalknots(d[[exposure_var]],fun="ns",df=exposure_df); lb<-build_lag_basis(max_lag,lag_df,lag_knots); cb<-tryCatch(crossbasis(lm,lag=max_lag,argvar=list(fun="ns",knots=var_knots),arglag=lb),error=function(e) NULL); if(is.null(cb)||qr(cb)$rank<ncol(cb)) { if(is.null(cb)) return(NULL) }; fit<-tryCatch(gnm(as.formula(paste0(outcome_var," ~ cb")),eliminate=factor(d[[stratum_var]]),family=quasipoisson(),data=d),error=function(e) NULL); if(is.null(fit)) return(NULL); pr0<-tryCatch(crosspred_aligned(cb,fit,by=by),error=function(e) NULL); q<-quantile(d[[exposure_var]],MMT_SEARCH_RANGE,na.rm=TRUE); MMT<-NA_real_; max_RR<-NA_real_; if(!is.null(pr0)){ii<-pr0$predvar>=q[1]&pr0$predvar<=q[2]; if(any(ii)) MMT<-pr0$predvar[ii][which.min(pr0$allRRfit[ii])]; max_RR<-max(pr0$allRRfit,na.rm=TRUE)}; centre_value<-if(is.null(cen)) if(is.na(MMT)) median(d[[exposure_var]],na.rm=TRUE) else MMT else cen; pred<-tryCatch(crosspred_aligned(cb,fit,cen=centre_value,by=by),error=function(e) pr0); list(data=d,cb=cb,fit=fit,pred=pred,pred0=pr0,MMT=MMT,centre_value=centre_value,var_knots=var_knots,lag_basis=lb,metrics=compute_model_metrics(fit,cb,MMT,max_lag,exposure_df,lag_df,max_RR))}
```

```{r helpers-plots}
rr_axis_breaks <- function(pred,rr_cap=10){yhi<-max(pred$allRRhigh,na.rm=TRUE);ylo<-max(0,floor(min(pred$allRRlow,na.rm=TRUE)*2)/2);hi<-ceiling(min(yhi,rr_cap)*2)/2;list(ylim=c(ylo,hi),breaks=seq(ylo,hi,.5),truncated=yhi>rr_cap,true_max=yhi)}
plot_curve_overlay <- function(results,labels=NULL,title="",xlab="UTCI (°C)",ylab="Cumulative Relative Risk",show_mmt=TRUE,show_ci=FALSE){results<-results[!vapply(results,is.null,logical(1))]; if(!length(results)) stop("No valid models supplied."); if(is.null(labels)) labels<-names(results); if(is.null(labels)) labels<-paste("Model",seq_along(results)); df<-purrr::imap_dfr(results,function(x,nm){tibble(model=nm,UTCI=x$pred$predvar,RR=x$pred$allRRfit,low=x$pred$allRRlow,high=x$pred$allRRhigh,MMT=x$MMT)}); p<-ggplot(df,aes(UTCI,RR,group=model,linetype=model))+geom_hline(yintercept=1,linetype=2)+geom_line(linewidth=.9)+labs(title=title,x=xlab,y=ylab,linetype=NULL)+theme_bw(); if(show_ci) p<-p+geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=low,ymax=high),alpha=.15,colour=NA); if(show_mmt) p<-p+geom_vline(data=distinct(df,model,MMT),aes(xintercept=MMT),linetype=2,inherit.aes=FALSE); p}
plot_candidate_models <- function(all_results,diagnostics_tbl,highlight_id=NULL,title="Candidate DLNM specifications"){ids<-names(all_results); ids<-ids[ids%in%diagnostics_tbl$model_id]; labs<-ids; if(!is.null(highlight_id)) labs[ids==highlight_id]<-paste0("Primary: ",highlight_id); plot_curve_overlay(all_results[ids],labs,title)}
plot_lag_response <- function(pred,at,title=NULL){a<-pred$predvar[which.min(abs(pred$predvar-at))]; plot(pred,"slices",var=a,ci="area",xlab="Lag (days)",ylab="Relative Risk",main=title %||% paste0("Lag-response at UTCI = ",round(a,1)))}
plot_contour_surface <- function(pred,title="Exposure-lag-response contour"){plot(pred,"contour",xlab="UTCI (°C)",ylab="Lag (days)",main=title)}
plot_3d_surface <- function(pred,title="3D exposure-lag-response surface"){plot(pred,theta=220,phi=35,shade=.4,xlab="UTCI (°C)",ylab="Lag (days)",zlab="RR",main=title)}
plot_centre_curves <- function(fits,title="Centre-specific cumulative exposure-response curves"){df<-purrr::imap_dfr(fits,~tibble(centre=.y,UTCI=.x$pred$predvar,RR=.x$pred$allRRfit));ggplot(df,aes(UTCI,RR,group=centre,colour=centre))+geom_line(linewidth=.7)+geom_hline(yintercept=1,linetype=2)+labs(title=title,x="UTCI (°C)",y="Relative Risk",colour="Centre")+theme_bw()}
plot_country_curves <- function(fits,cb,cen,title="Country-level exposure-response curves"){df<-purrr::imap_dfr(fits,~tibble(country=.x$country,UTCI=.x$pred$predvar,RR=.x$pred$allRRfit));ggplot(df,aes(UTCI,RR,group=country,linetype=country))+geom_line()+geom_hline(yintercept=1,linetype=2)+labs(title=title,x="UTCI (°C)",y="Relative Risk",linetype="Country")+theme_bw()}
plot_meta_curve <- function(pred,mmt,title="Pooled exposure-response curve"){df<-tibble(UTCI=pred$predvar,RR=pred$allRRfit,low=pred$allRRlow,high=pred$allRRhigh);ggplot(df,aes(UTCI,RR))+geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=low,ymax=high),alpha=.2)+geom_line(linewidth=1)+geom_hline(yintercept=1,linetype=2)+geom_vline(xintercept=mmt,linetype=2)+labs(title=title,x="UTCI (°C)",y="Relative Risk")+theme_bw()}
forest_plot_mixmeta <- function(fits,meta_fit,cb,at,cen,title="Centre-specific and pooled RR"){rows<-purrr::imap_dfr(fits,function(f,id){pr<-tryCatch(crosspred_aligned(f$cb,f$fit,cen=cen,at=at),error=function(e)NULL);if(is.null(pr))return(NULL);tibble(centre=id,RR=as.numeric(pr$allRRfit[1]),low=as.numeric(pr$allRRlow[1]),high=as.numeric(pr$allRRhigh[1]))});pr<-tryCatch(crosspred(cb,coef=coef(meta_fit),vcov=vcov(meta_fit),model.link="log",cen=cen,at=at),error=function(e)NULL);if(!is.null(pr))rows<-bind_rows(rows,tibble(centre="Overall pooled",RR=as.numeric(pr$allRRfit[1]),low=as.numeric(pr$allRRlow[1]),high=as.numeric(pr$allRRhigh[1])));ggplot(rows,aes(RR,forcats::fct_reorder(centre,RR)))+geom_vline(xintercept=1,linetype=2)+geom_errorbar(aes(xmin=low,xmax=high),height=.2)+geom_point(size=2.5)+labs(title=title,x=paste0("RR at UTCI=",round(at,1)," vs MMT=",round(cen,1)),y=NULL)+theme_bw()}
create_percentile_plot <- function(pred,exposure_data,percentile,label,prefix=""){u<-quantile(exposure_data,percentile,na.rm=TRUE); i<-which.min(abs(pred$predvar-u)); tibble(Lag=0:(ncol(pred$matRRfit)-1),RR=pred$matRRfit[i,],low=pred$matRRlow[i,],high=pred$matRRhigh[i,]) %>% ggplot(aes(Lag,RR))+geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=low,ymax=high),alpha=.2)+geom_line(linewidth=.9)+geom_hline(yintercept=1,linetype=2)+labs(title=paste0(prefix,label," percentile (UTCI ",round(pred$predvar[i],1),"°C)"),x="Lag (days)",y="Relative Risk")+theme_bw()}
```

```{r helpers-centre-meta}
fit_one_centre <- function(centre_data,centre_id,spec,var_knots,lag_knots,cen,min_deaths=MIN_CENTRE_DEATHS,max_kappa=KAPPA_MAX){fail<-function(r) list(centre_id=centre_id,excluded=TRUE,reason=r); nd<-sum(centre_data[[OUTCOME_VAR]]==1,na.rm=TRUE); if(nd<min_deaths) return(fail(paste0("too few deaths (",nd," < ",min_deaths,")"))); res<-run_dlnm_spec(centre_data,max_lag=spec$max_lag,exposure_df=spec$exposure_df,lag_df=spec$lag_df,var_knots=var_knots,lag_knots=lag_knots,cen=cen); if(is.null(res)) return(fail("DLNM fit/crossbasis failed")); m<-res$metrics; if(!m$converged) return(fail("gnm did not converge")); if(!m$full_rank) return(fail(paste0("rank-deficient crossbasis (rank ",m$rank,"/",m$n_basis,")"))); if(!is.na(m$kappa)&&m$kappa>max_kappa) return(fail(paste0("excessive collinearity (kappa=",round(m$kappa,1),")"))); red<-tryCatch({a<-cb_coef_vcov(res$cb,res$fit); crossreduce(res$cb,coef=a$coef,vcov=a$vcov,cen=cen)},error=function(e) NULL); if(is.null(red)) return(fail("crossreduce() failed after coefficient/VCOV alignment")); pick<-function(z) if(z%in%names(centre_data)) unique(centre_data[[z]])[1] else NA_character_; list(centre_id=centre_id,excluded=FALSE,reason=NA_character_,centre_name=pick("centre_name"),country=pick("country"),climate_zone=pick("climate_zone"),centre_label=pick("centre_label"),n_deaths=nd,fit=res$fit,cb=res$cb,pred=res$pred,data=res$data,reduced=red,metrics=m,MMT=res$MMT)}
two_stage_pool <- function(data,group_col="centreid",spec,var_knots,lag_knots,cen,min_deaths=MIN_CENTRE_DEATHS,max_kappa=KAPPA_MAX){groups<-split(data,data[[group_col]]); raw<-purrr::imap(groups,~fit_one_centre(.x,.y,spec,var_knots,lag_knots,cen,min_deaths,max_kappa)); exclusion_report<-purrr::imap_dfr(raw,~tibble(centreid=.y,n_deaths=sum(groups[[.y]][[OUTCOME_VAR]]==1,na.rm=TRUE),status=if(isTRUE(.x$excluded))"EXCLUDED" else "RETAINED",reason=if(isTRUE(.x$excluded)) .x$reason else "passed Stage 1 QC")); exclusion_report%>%format_ft(); write_csv(exclusion_report,"Results/CentreModels/Centre_Exclusion_Report.csv"); fits<-raw[!purrr::map_lgl(raw,~isTRUE(.x$excluded))]; if(length(fits)<2) stop("Fewer than two centres passed QC -- inspect Results/CentreModels/Centre_Exclusion_Report.csv."); coefs<-purrr::map(fits,~.x$reduced$coefficients); vcovs<-purrr::map(fits,~.x$reduced$vcov); if(length(unique(purrr::map_int(coefs,length)))>1) stop("Retained centre coefficient dimensions differ."); cm<-do.call(rbind,coefs); rownames(cm)<-names(fits); mf<-mixmeta(cm,vcovs,method="reml"); qc<-purrr::imap_dfr(fits,~tibble(centreid=.y,centre_name=.x$centre_name,country=.x$country,climate_zone=.x$climate_zone,deaths=.x$n_deaths,kappa=.x$metrics$kappa,dispersion=.x$metrics$dispersion,QAIC=.x$metrics$QAIC,MMT=.x$MMT)); list(fits=fits,qc=qc,exclusion_report=exclusion_report,coef_list=coefs,vcov_list=vcovs,coef_matrix=cm,meta_fit=mf,n_groups=length(fits))}
heterogeneity_summary <- function(meta_fit){s<-summary(meta_fit);Q<-s$qstat$Q;df<-s$qstat$df;p<-s$qstat$pvalue;I2<-ifelse(Q>0,max(0,(Q-df)/Q)*100,NA);tibble(n_groups=meta_fit$nobs,Q=round(Q,2),df=df,p_value=signif(p,3),I2=round(I2,1),tau2=round(mean(diag(meta_fit$Psi)),5),AIC=round(AIC(meta_fit),2),BIC=round(BIC(meta_fit),2))}
leave_one_out_meta <- function(cm,vcovs){purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(cm)),function(i){m<-tryCatch(mixmeta(cm[-i,,drop=FALSE],vcovs[-i],method="reml"),error=function(e)NULL);if(is.null(m)) tibble(omitted=rownames(cm)[i],status="failed") else tibble(omitted=rownames(cm)[i],status="ok",AIC=AIC(m),tau2=mean(diag(m$Psi)))})}
```

```{r desc-utci}
# UTCI metric correlation: high correlation between min/mean/max is expected
# and NOT a stability problem by itself (that is checked via crossbasis kappa
# in Section 07, on utci_mean alone, which is what is actually modelled).
utci_cor <- cases %>% select(utci_min, utci_mean, utci_max) %>% cor(use = "complete.obs")
utci_cor %>% as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column("metric") %>% format_ft()
corrplot(utci_cor, method = "color", type = "upper", addCoef.col = "black",
         tl.col = "black", tl.srt = 45, diag = FALSE,
         title = "UTCI metric correlation (min/mean/max)", mar = c(0, 0, 2, 0))

ggplot(cases, aes(.data[[EXPOSURE_VAR]])) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "steelblue", colour = "white") +
  labs(x = "UTCI (\u00b0C)", y = "Frequency", title = "UTCI on case days")
ggsave("Results/Descriptives/UTCI_Histogram.png", width = 8, height = 6)

# v5: UTCI by country -- quick visual complement to the Table_UTCI_by_country
# summary above (same data, easier to eyeball spread/outliers per country).
ggplot(cases, aes(country, .data[[EXPOSURE_VAR]], fill = country)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "UTCI (\u00b0C)", title = "UTCI distribution by country")
ggsave("Results/Descriptives/UTCI_by_Country.png", width = 8, height = 6)
```

# Section 07. Crossbasis selection (multi-criteria, sequential-gate framework)

```{r cb-candidates}
candidate_specs <- expand_grid(max_lag = c(7, 14, 21, 28), exposure_df = c(3, 4, 5), lag_df = c(3, 4))
candidate_specs <- candidate_specs %>% mutate(spec_id = paste0("Lag", max_lag, "_E", exposure_df, "_L", lag_df))

all_results <- candidate_specs %>%
  pmap(~ run_dlnm_spec(analysis_ready_matrix, max_lag = ..1, exposure_df = ..2, lag_df = ..3, quiet = TRUE))
names(all_results) <- candidate_specs$spec_id
```

```{r cb-diagnostics-table}
diagnostics_tbl <- imap_dfr(all_results, function(res, id) {
  if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)
  res$metrics %>% mutate(model_id = id)
})
diagnostics_tbl %>% arrange(QAIC) %>% format_ft()
```

```{r cb-qaic-heatmap, fig.width=6.5, fig.height=5}
ggplot(diagnostics_tbl, aes(factor(exposure_df), factor(lag_df), fill = QAIC)) +
  facet_wrap(~max_lag) + geom_tile(colour = "white") + geom_text(aes(label = round(QAIC,0)), size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() + labs(x = "Exposure df", y = "Lag df", title = "Figure 4. QAIC by lag window")
```

## Manual model selection — primary decision

The final model is selected **manually and explicitly**, using the complete
candidate evidence rather than an automatic QAIC ranking.

The decision criteria are, in this order:

1. epidemiological plausibility of the exposure-response shape;
2. adequate exposure support across the relevant percentiles;
3. stable and interpretable MMT;
4. stable lag-response behaviour;
5. full-rank crossbasis;
6. acceptable numerical conditioning;
7. acceptable dispersion/convergence;
8. absence of implausible tail explosions;
9. parsimony;
10. QAIC/log-likelihood as **supporting evidence only**.

For this primary analysis, the manually locked primary specification is
**Lag14_E3_L3**. Lag 21 is retained as a sensitivity specification.

```{r cb-lock}
PRIMARY_MODEL_ID <- "Lag14_E3_L3"; SENSITIVITY_MODEL_ID <- "Lag21_E3_L3"
if(!PRIMARY_MODEL_ID %in% names(all_results)) stop("Primary model not available: ",PRIMARY_MODEL_ID)
if(!SENSITIVITY_MODEL_ID %in% names(all_results)) stop("Sensitivity model not available: ",SENSITIVITY_MODEL_ID)
best_id <- PRIMARY_MODEL_ID; best_fit <- all_results[[PRIMARY_MODEL_ID]]; sensitivity_fit <- all_results[[SENSITIVITY_MODEL_ID]]
best_spec <- list(model_id=PRIMARY_MODEL_ID,max_lag=14L,exposure_df=3L,lag_df=3L,var_knots=best_fit$var_knots,lag_knots=best_fit$lag_basis$knots,MMT=best_fit$MMT,cen=best_fit$MMT)
sensitivity_spec <- list(model_id=SENSITIVITY_MODEL_ID,max_lag=21L,exposure_df=3L,lag_df=3L,var_knots=sensitivity_fit$var_knots,lag_knots=sensitivity_fit$lag_basis$knots,MMT=sensitivity_fit$MMT,cen=sensitivity_fit$MMT)
MMT <- best_spec$MMT; sensitivity_MMT <- sensitivity_spec$MMT
saveRDS(best_spec,"Results/Objects/primary_specification_Lag14_E3L3.rds"); saveRDS(sensitivity_spec,"Results/Objects/sensitivity_specification_Lag21_E3L3.rds"); saveRDS(best_fit,"Results/Objects/primary_model_Lag14_E3L3.rds"); saveRDS(sensitivity_fit,"Results/Objects/sensitivity_model_Lag21_E3L3.rds")
manual_selection_record <- tibble(role=c("Primary","Sensitivity"),model_id=c(PRIMARY_MODEL_ID,SENSITIVITY_MODEL_ID),max_lag=c(14L,21L),exposure_df=3L,lag_df=3L,MMT=c(MMT,sensitivity_MMT),selection="Prespecified manual model lock; no automated decision rule")
manual_selection_record %>% format_ft(); write_csv(manual_selection_record,"Results/Crossbasis/Manual_Model_Selection.csv")
```

```{r diag-mmt-bootstrap}
## ---- v4: replaced 1000x data-resample-and-refit with Monte Carlo simulation
## from the fitted coefficients' sampling distribution. This is the standard
## approach for CIs on a *derived* nonlinear quantity from a DLNM (the same
## mechanism attrdl(..., sim=TRUE) uses internally, and the same mechanism
## already used elsewhere in this document for the pooled meta-analytic
## curve via crosspred(cb, coef=, vcov=, ...)). No data resampling, no model
## refitting: just repeated evaluation of the already-fitted curve. Runs in
## seconds. It captures coefficient-sampling uncertainty conditional on the
## locked crossbasis spec -- which is what you want here, since spec
## uncertainty (knot placement, df) was already handled by the sequential-
## gate search in Section 07.
## v4.1: 10,000 draws (free -- each draw is a crosspred() evaluation, not a
## refit), sub-grid MMT via splinefun()+optimize() instead of which.min() on
## a by=0.1 grid, and a simultaneous confidence band built from the SAME
## draws used for the MMT distribution (no extra simulation cost).
mmt_mc_uncertainty <- function(fit, cb, exposure_data,
                                mmt_range = MMT_SEARCH_RANGE,
                                by = 0.1, nsim = 10000, seed = 1) {
  set.seed(seed)
  b  <- coef(fit)     # crossbasis coefficients only (stratum nuisance params already eliminated)
  Vb <- vcov(fit)
  sim_coefs <- MASS::mvrnorm(nsim, mu = b, Sigma = Vb)

  q <- quantile(exposure_data, mmt_range, na.rm = TRUE)

  # Fixed prediction grid, shared across all draws, so curves are directly
  # comparable column-by-column (needed for the simultaneous band below).
  base_pred  <- crosspred(cb, coef = b, vcov = Vb, model.link = "log", by = by)
  predvar    <- base_pred$predvar
  in_range   <- predvar >= q[1] & predvar <= q[2]
  log_rr_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nsim, ncol = length(predvar))
  mmt_sim    <- rep(NA_real_, nsim)

  for (i in seq_len(nsim)) {
    pr <- tryCatch(crosspred(cb, coef = sim_coefs[i, ], vcov = Vb, model.link = "log", by = by),
                    error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(pr)) next
    log_rr_mat[i, ] <- log(pr$allRRfit)

    if (any(in_range)) {
      # Sub-grid MMT: spline-interpolate the log-RR curve within the search
      # range and optimize(), rather than reading off the by=0.1 grid.
      sf  <- splinefun(predvar[in_range], log_rr_mat[i, in_range], method = "natural")
      opt <- optimize(sf, interval = range(predvar[in_range]))
      mmt_sim[i] <- opt$minimum
    }
  }

  list(mmt = mmt_sim, predvar = predvar, log_rr_mat = log_rr_mat)
}

mc_out <- tryCatch(mmt_mc_uncertainty(fit, cb, dat[[EXPOSURE_VAR]], nsim = 10000), error=function(e) { message("MMT Monte Carlo uncertainty unavailable: ",conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
boot_mmt <- mc_out$mmt

tibble(N_sim = length(boot_mmt), Median_MMT = median(boot_mmt, na.rm = TRUE),
       CI_low = quantile(boot_mmt, .025, na.rm = TRUE), CI_high = quantile(boot_mmt, .975, na.rm = TRUE),
       N_failed = sum(is.na(boot_mmt))) %>%
  format_ft()
```

```{r diag-mmt-simultaneous-band, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
if (exists("mc_out") && !is.null(mc_out$log_rr_mat)) {

  valid_cols <- colSums(is.finite(mc_out$log_rr_mat)) >= 0.80 * nrow(mc_out$log_rr_mat)

  if (sum(valid_cols) >= 10) {

    mat <- mc_out$log_rr_mat[, valid_cols, drop = FALSE]
    predvar_band <- mc_out$predvar[valid_cols]

    mean_log_rr <- colMeans(mat, na.rm = TRUE)
    sd_log_rr <- apply(mat, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)

    sd_log_rr[!is.finite(sd_log_rr) | sd_log_rr <= 0] <- NA_real_

    z_scores <- sweep(mat, 2, mean_log_rr, "-")
    z_scores <- sweep(z_scores, 2, sd_log_rr, "/")

    max_abs_z <- apply(abs(z_scores), 1, max, na.rm = TRUE)
    crit_val <- as.numeric(
      quantile(max_abs_z, 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
    )

    if (is.finite(crit_val)) {

      band_df <- tibble(
        UTCI = predvar_band,
        RR_fit = exp(mean_log_rr),
        RR_simul_low = exp(mean_log_rr - crit_val * sd_log_rr),
        RR_simul_high = exp(mean_log_rr + crit_val * sd_log_rr),
        RR_pointwise_low = exp(
          mean_log_rr - qnorm(.975) * sd_log_rr
        ),
        RR_pointwise_high = exp(
          mean_log_rr + qnorm(.975) * sd_log_rr
        )
      ) %>%
        filter(
          is.finite(RR_fit),
          is.finite(RR_simul_low),
          is.finite(RR_simul_high),
          is.finite(RR_pointwise_low),
          is.finite(RR_pointwise_high)
        )

      p_simul_band <- ggplot(
        band_df,
        aes(UTCI, RR_fit)
      ) +
        geom_ribbon(
          aes(
            ymin = RR_simul_low,
            ymax = RR_simul_high
          ),
          alpha = .35
        ) +
        geom_ribbon(
          aes(
            ymin = RR_pointwise_low,
            ymax = RR_pointwise_high
          ),
          alpha = .20
        ) +
        geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
        geom_hline(
          yintercept = 1,
          linetype = 2
        ) +
        geom_vline(
          xintercept = MMT,
          linetype = 2
        ) +
        labs(
          title = "Pointwise and 95% simultaneous confidence bands",
          x = "UTCI (°C)",
          y = "Relative Risk"
        )

      p_simul_band
      safe_save_plot(
        p_simul_band,
        "Results/Diagnostics/MMT_Simultaneous_Band.png",
        8, 6
      )
    }
  }
}
```

# Section 09. Fit centre-specific models (Stage 1)

Centre-specific models are fitted independently under the locked 14-day, exposure-df=3, lag-df=3 specification. Centres are retained for Stage 2 only when the local crossbasis is identifiable, the model converges, numerical conditioning is acceptable, and the reduced coefficient/covariance structure is valid. Any exclusions are reported explicitly with their technical reason.

```{r centre-models}
stage1_raw <- split(dat, dat$centreid)

stage1_fits <- purrr::imap(
  stage1_raw,
  function(d, id) {
    fit_one_centre(
      centre_data = d,
      centre_id = id,
      spec = best_spec,
      var_knots = best_spec$var_knots,
      lag_knots = best_spec$lag_knots,
      cen = MMT,
      min_deaths = MIN_CENTRE_DEATHS,
      max_kappa = KAPPA_MAX
    )
  }
)

stage1_qc <- purrr::imap_dfr(
  stage1_fits,
  function(x, id) {
    tibble(
      centreid = id,
      centre_name = x$centre_name %||% NA_character_,
      country = x$country %||% NA_character_,
      climate_zone = x$climate_zone %||% NA_character_,
      status = if (isTRUE(x$excluded)) "EXCLUDED" else "RETAINED",
      reason = if (isTRUE(x$excluded)) x$reason else "passed Stage 1 QC",
      deaths = if (!is.null(x$n_deaths)) x$n_deaths else sum(stage1_raw[[id]][[OUTCOME_VAR]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
      rank = if (!is.null(x$metrics)) x$metrics$rank else NA_integer_,
      n_basis = if (!is.null(x$metrics)) x$metrics$n_basis else NA_integer_,
      kappa = if (!is.null(x$metrics)) x$metrics$kappa else NA_real_,
      dispersion = if (!is.null(x$metrics)) x$metrics$dispersion else NA_real_,
      converged = if (!is.null(x$metrics)) x$metrics$converged else FALSE
    )
  }
)

stage1_qc <- stage1_qc %>%
  left_join(
    centre_lookup %>% select(centreid, centre_name, country, climate_zone),
    by = "centreid",
    suffix = c("", ".lookup")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    centre_name = coalesce(centre_name, centre_name.lookup),
    country = coalesce(country, country.lookup),
    climate_zone = coalesce(climate_zone, climate_zone.lookup)
  ) %>%
  select(-ends_with(".lookup"))

stage1_qc %>% arrange(desc(status), desc(deaths)) %>% format_ft()

write_csv(stage1_qc, "Results/CentreModels/STAGE1_QC.csv")

retained_ids <- stage1_qc %>%
  filter(status == "RETAINED") %>%
  pull(centreid)

if (length(retained_ids) < 2) {
  stop(
    "Fewer than two centres passed Stage 1 QC. ",
    "Inspect Results/CentreModels/STAGE1_QC.csv."
  )
}

# Construct the pooling object only from centres that actually passed
# the locked specification and numerical QC.
retained_fits <- stage1_fits[retained_ids]

coef_list <- purrr::map(retained_fits, ~ .x$reduced$coefficients)
vcov_list <- purrr::map(retained_fits, ~ .x$reduced$vcov)

coef_lengths <- purrr::map_int(coef_list, length)

if (length(unique(coef_lengths)) != 1) {
  stop(
    "Stage 1 coefficient dimensions differ across retained centres: ",
    paste(unique(coef_lengths), collapse = ", "),
    ". The locked specification must generate identical reduced dimensions."
  )
}

coef_matrix <- do.call(rbind, coef_list)
rownames(coef_matrix) <- retained_ids

# Validate every centre covariance matrix before Stage 2.
vcov_ok <- purrr::map_lgl(
  vcov_list,
  function(V) {
    is.matrix(V) &&
      nrow(V) == ncol(V) &&
      nrow(V) == ncol(coef_matrix) &&
      all(is.finite(V)) &&
      max(abs(V - t(V))) < 1e-8
  }
)

if (!all(vcov_ok)) {
  bad_vcov <- names(vcov_list)[!vcov_ok]
  stop(
    "Invalid Stage 1 covariance matrix for centre(s): ",
    paste(bad_vcov, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

west_africa_model <- tryCatch(
  mixmeta(
    coef_matrix,
    vcov_list,
    method = "reml"
  ),
  error = function(e) {
    stop(
      "Stage 2 mixmeta failed after successful Stage 1 QC. ",
      "This is a true pooling/model-fitting problem: ",
      conditionMessage(e)
    )
  }
)

pooled <- list(
  fits = retained_fits,
  qc = stage1_qc %>% filter(status == "RETAINED"),
  exclusion_report = stage1_qc,
  coef_list = coef_list,
  vcov_list = vcov_list,
  coef_matrix = coef_matrix,
  meta_fit = west_africa_model,
  n_groups = length(retained_fits)
)

saveRDS(pooled, "Results/Objects/pooled_stage1_stage2.rds")
saveRDS(coef_list, "Results/CentreModels/coef_list.rds")
saveRDS(vcov_list, "Results/CentreModels/vcov_list.rds")

stage1_summary <- stage1_qc %>%
  count(status) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)
  )

stage1_summary %>% format_ft()
```

## Section 10.2. Meta-regression: why do centres differ? (Table 4)

`country` and `climate_zone` enter as FIXED-effect meta-predictors here, to
test how much of the between-centre heterogeneity they explain -- this is
the "meta-regression" step in the flow chart, run on the same pooled
coefficient matrix as the baseline model (no separate re-pooling).

```{r meta-regression}
meta_data_hier <- pooled$qc %>%
  distinct(
    centreid,
    centre_name,
    country,
    climate_zone
  )

cov_path <- "Data/CentreCovariates.csv"
if (file.exists(cov_path)) {
  meta_data_hier <- meta_data_hier %>%
    left_join(
      read_csv(cov_path, show_col_types = FALSE),
      by = "centreid"
    )
}

meta_data_hier <- meta_data_hier[
  match(
    rownames(pooled$coef_matrix),
    meta_data_hier$centreid
  ),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

if (!identical(
  meta_data_hier$centreid,
  rownames(pooled$coef_matrix)
)) {
  stop(
    "Meta-regression centre ordering does not match the Stage 1 coefficient matrix."
  )
}

meta_reg_results <- list()

meta_reg_results$climate <- tryCatch(
  mixmeta(
    pooled$coef_matrix ~ factor(climate_zone),
    vcov = pooled$vcov_list,
    data = meta_data_hier,
    method = "reml"
  ),
  error = function(e) {
    message("Climate-zone meta-regression not estimable: ", conditionMessage(e))
    NULL
  }
)

meta_reg_results$country <- tryCatch(
  mixmeta(
    pooled$coef_matrix ~ country,
    vcov = pooled$vcov_list,
    data = meta_data_hier,
    method = "reml"
  ),
  error = function(e) {
    message("Country meta-regression not estimable: ", conditionMessage(e))
    NULL
  }
)

tau0 <- mean(diag(west_africa_model$Psi))

meta_reg_summary_row <- function(label, model) {
  if (is.null(model)) {
    return(tibble(
      Model = label,
      logLik = NA_real_,
      AIC = NA_real_,
      Heterogeneity_explained_pct = NA_real_,
      status = "Not estimable"
    ))
  }

  tau <- mean(diag(model$Psi))

  tibble(
    Model = label,
    logLik = as.numeric(logLik(model)),
    AIC = AIC(model),
    Heterogeneity_explained_pct =
      round(100 * max(0, (tau0 - tau) / tau0), 1),
    status = "Estimated"
  )
}

table4_meta <- bind_rows(
  meta_reg_summary_row(
    "Pooled (no covariates)",
    west_africa_model
  ),
  meta_reg_summary_row(
    "+ Climate zone",
    meta_reg_results$climate
  ),
  meta_reg_summary_row(
    "+ Country",
    meta_reg_results$country
  )
)

table4_meta %>% format_ft()

save_as_docx(
  format_ft(table4_meta),
  path = "Results/MetaRegression/Table4_MetaRegression.docx"
)

write_csv(
  table4_meta,
  "Results/MetaRegression/Table4_MetaRegression.csv"
)

saveRDS(
  meta_reg_results,
  "Results/MetaRegression/meta_regression_models.rds"
)
```


## Section 10.3. Multilevel BLUPs: centre AND country (Table 3)

The flow chart's next step is BLUPs "for each centre and each country" --
that is a genuine empirical-Bayes shrinkage estimate, which requires
`country` to be a nested RANDOM-effects level above `centreid`
(`random = ~1|country/centreid`), not a fixed covariate. Fixed-effect
`country` dummies (Section 10.2) test whether country explains
heterogeneity; this nested model instead lets each country's curve borrow
statistical strength from the whole region. `mixmeta::blup(..., level=)`
returns predictions at either grouping level of the same fitted model.

```{r multilevel-blups}
# meta_data_hier was already re-aligned to rownames(pooled$coef_matrix) in
# the meta-regression chunk above and is reused here unchanged.
meta_multilevel <- tryCatch(
  mixmeta(pooled$coef_matrix, S = pooled$vcov_list, random = ~ 1 | country/centreid,
          data = meta_data_hier, method = "reml"),
  error = function(e) { message("Multilevel model failed to fit: ", e$message); NULL }
)

if (!is.null(meta_multilevel)) {
  saveRDS(meta_multilevel, "Results/Meta/WestAfrica_multilevel_mixmeta.rds")

  # Centre-level BLUPs (shrunken toward their own country's mean, and the region)
  blups_centre <- blup(meta_multilevel, level = "centreid", vcov = TRUE)
  table_blup_centre <- imap_dfr(blups_centre, function(b, id) {
    cp <- crosspred(cb, coef = b$blup, vcov = b$vcov, model.link = "log", cen = MMT, at = p99)
    tibble(centreid = id, RR_at_P99 = round(cp$allRRfit, 3), low = round(cp$allRRlow, 3), high = round(cp$allRRhigh, 3))
  }) %>% left_join(meta_data_hier, by = "centreid") %>% arrange(country, centreid)
  table_blup_centre %>% format_ft()

  # Table 3: country-level BLUPs -- the genuine shrinkage estimate the flow chart specifies
  blups_country <- blup(meta_multilevel, level = "country", vcov = TRUE)
  table3_country <- imap_dfr(blups_country, function(b, ctry) {
    cp <- crosspred(cb, coef = b$blup, vcov = b$vcov, model.link = "log", cen = MMT, at = p99)
    tibble(country = ctry, RR_at_P99 = round(cp$allRRfit, 3), low = round(cp$allRRlow, 3), high = round(cp$allRRhigh, 3))
  })
  table3_country %>% format_ft()
  save_as_docx(format_ft(table3_country), path = "Results/MetaRegression/Table3_Country_BLUPs.docx")
  save_as_docx(format_ft(table_blup_centre), path = "Results/MetaRegression/Centre_BLUPs_multilevel.docx")
} else {
  message("Falling back to the unconditional centre BLUPs already computed in Section 10 ",
          "(blup(west_africa_model)) -- those do not borrow strength across countries, ",
          "so treat country-level conclusions with more caution if this fallback is in effect.")
}
```

# Objective 1. Attributable mortality burden

Primary split: Cold (< MMT) vs Heat (>= MMT) -- the appropriate convention
for a population adapted to a warm baseline. Reported alongside the
Gasparrini et al. (2015, *Lancet*) four-way decomposition of the extreme
tails: extreme cold (< P5), moderate cold (P5-MMT), moderate heat
(MMT-P95), extreme heat (> P95). Requires `FluMoDL::attrdl()`.

```{r attributable-fraction}
af_component <- function(exp_var,cb_,outcome_,model_,cen_,range_=NULL){if(!flumodl_ok)return(NA_real_);tryCatch(FluMoDL::attrdl(exp_var,cb_,outcome_,model=model_,type="af",dir="forw",cen=cen_,range=range_),error=function(e)NA_real_)}
make_af_table <- function(x,cbx,y,fitx,cenx){p5x<-quantile(x,.05,na.rm=TRUE);p95x<-quantile(x,.95,na.rm=TRUE);afs<-c(Total=af_component(x,cbx,y,fitx,cenx,NULL),Cold=af_component(x,cbx,y,fitx,cenx,c(-Inf,cenx)),Heat=af_component(x,cbx,y,fitx,cenx,c(cenx,Inf)),Extreme_cold=af_component(x,cbx,y,fitx,cenx,c(-Inf,p5x)),Moderate_cold=af_component(x,cbx,y,fitx,cenx,c(p5x,cenx)),Moderate_heat=af_component(x,cbx,y,fitx,cenx,c(cenx,p95x)),Extreme_heat=af_component(x,cbx,y,fitx,cenx,c(p95x,Inf))); nd<-sum(y==1,na.rm=TRUE); tibble(component=names(afs),attributable_fraction_pct=round(100*as.numeric(afs),2),attributable_deaths=round(nd*as.numeric(afs),1))}
table5_af <- make_af_table(dat[[EXPOSURE_VAR]],cb,dat[[OUTCOME_VAR]],fit,MMT); table5_af %>% format_ft(); write_csv(table5_af,"Results/AttributableFraction/Table5_Attributable_Fraction.csv"); save_as_docx(format_ft(table5_af),path="Results/AttributableFraction/Table5_Attributable_Fraction.docx")
af_plot_data<-table5_af%>%filter(component!="Total")
p_af<-ggplot(af_plot_data,aes(component,attributable_fraction_pct))+geom_col()+geom_hline(yintercept=0,linetype=2)+labs(title="Attributable mortality fraction by thermal stress category",x=NULL,y="Attributable fraction (%)")+theme_bw()+theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=25,hjust=1)); print(p_af); save_pub_plot(p_af,"Results/AttributableFraction/Attributable_Fraction_ColdHeat.png",8,5)
if(flumodl_ok){sensitivity_af<-make_af_table(sensitivity_fit$data[[EXPOSURE_VAR]],sensitivity_fit$cb,sensitivity_fit$data[[OUTCOME_VAR]],sensitivity_fit$fit,sensitivity_MMT); sensitivity_af%>%format_ft();write_csv(sensitivity_af,"Results/AttributableFraction/Table5_Attributable_Fraction_Sensitivity_Lag21.csv")}
if(exists("pooled")&&length(pooled$fits)>0){af_by_centre<-purrr::imap_dfr(pooled$fits,function(cf,cid){cd<-cf$data;z<-make_af_table(cd[[EXPOSURE_VAR]],cf$cb,cd[[OUTCOME_VAR]],cf$fit,MMT);tibble(centre=cid,AF_total_pct=z$attributable_fraction_pct[z$component=="Total"],AF_cold_pct=z$attributable_fraction_pct[z$component=="Cold"],AF_heat_pct=z$attributable_fraction_pct[z$component=="Heat"],attributable_deaths_total=z$attributable_deaths[z$component=="Total"],attributable_deaths_cold=z$attributable_deaths[z$component=="Cold"],attributable_deaths_heat=z$attributable_deaths[z$component=="Heat"]) }); af_by_centre%>%format_ft();write_csv(af_by_centre,"Results/AttributableFraction/Attributable_Fraction_by_Centre.csv")}
```

# Objective 2. Lag-response and harvesting characterisation

Immediate (lag 0), short (1-3), medium (4-7), delayed (8-14), and
harvesting (15-max_lag) windows, evaluated at moderate heat, extreme heat,
and cold. A dip below RR=1 in the harvesting window at heat exposures is
the mortality-displacement signature; a cumulative RR that stays elevated
through the harvesting window indicates true excess mortality rather than
short-term displacement.

```{r lag-characterisation}
lag_windows_tbl <- bind_rows(
  summarize_lag_windows(final_pred, MMT + 5, best_spec$max_lag, "Moderate heat (MMT+5)"),
  summarize_lag_windows(final_pred, MMT + 8, best_spec$max_lag, "Extreme heat (MMT+8)"),
  summarize_lag_windows(final_pred, MMT - 5, best_spec$max_lag, "Cold (MMT-5)")
)
lag_windows_tbl %>% format_ft()
save_as_docx(format_ft(lag_windows_tbl), path = "Results/LagCharacterisation/Lag_Window_Summary.docx")

p_lag_windows <- ggplot(lag_windows_tbl, aes(window, RR, fill = exposure_condition)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") + geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = 2) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Immediate", "Short", "Medium", "Delayed", "Harvesting")) +
  labs(title = "Figure. Cumulative RR by lag window", x = NULL, fill = NULL)
p_lag_windows
ggsave("Results/LagCharacterisation/Lag_Window_Barplot.png", plot = p_lag_windows, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

# Objective 3. Temporal adaptation

```{r temporal-adaptation, fig.width=7, fig.height=5,fig.cap="Temporal adaptation: early versus late periods within the primary tier."}
periods <- list(
  early = c(2011, 2012),
  late = c(2013, 2014)
)

period_pools <- purrr::imap(
  periods,
  function(rng, label) {

    pd <- dat %>%
      filter(
        year >= rng[1],
        year <= rng[2]
      )

    tryCatch(
      two_stage_pool(
        pd,
        spec = best_spec,
        var_knots = best_spec$var_knots,
        lag_knots = best_spec$lag_knots,
        cen = MMT
      ),
      error = function(e) {
        message(
          "Temporal period ", label,
          " could not be pooled: ",
          conditionMessage(e)
        )
        NULL
      }
    )
  }
)

valid_period_pools <- period_pools[
  !vapply(period_pools, is.null, logical(1))
]

if (length(valid_period_pools) >= 2) {

  period_preds <- purrr::imap(
    valid_period_pools,
    function(x, label) {
      tryCatch(
        crosspred(
          cb,
          coef = coef(x$meta_fit),
          vcov = vcov(x$meta_fit),
          model.link = "log",
          by = .1,
          cen = MMT
        ),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
    }
  )

  period_preds <- period_preds[
    !vapply(period_preds, is.null, logical(1))
  ]

  if (length(period_preds) >= 2) {

    period_curve_df <- purrr::imap_dfr(
      period_preds,
      function(pr, label) {
        tibble(
          period = label,
          UTCI = pr$predvar,
          RR = pr$allRRfit,
          low = pr$allRRlow,
          high = pr$allRRhigh
        )
      }
    )

    p_temporal <- ggplot(
      period_curve_df,
      aes(UTCI, RR, linetype = period)
    ) +
      geom_line(linewidth = .9) +
      geom_hline(
        yintercept = 1,
        linetype = 2
      ) +
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = MMT,
        linetype = 2
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "Temporal adaptation: early versus late",
        x = "UTCI (°C)",
        y = "Relative Risk",
        linetype = NULL
      )

    p_temporal

    safe_save_plot(
      p_temporal,
      "Results/TemporalAdaptation/Temporal_Adaptation_Curves.png",
      7, 5
    )

    temporal_summary <- purrr::imap_dfr(
      period_preds,
      function(pr, label) {
        idx <- which.min(
          abs(pr$predvar - p99)
        )

        tibble(
          period = label,
          RR_at_P99 = pr$allRRfit[idx],
          low = pr$allRRlow[idx],
          high = pr$allRRhigh[idx]
        )
      }
    )

    temporal_summary %>% format_ft()

    write_csv(
      temporal_summary,
      "Results/TemporalAdaptation/Temporal_Adaptation_Summary.csv"
    )

  } else {
    cat(
      "Temporal adaptation curve comparison was not estimable for two valid periods."
    )
  }

} else {
  cat(
    "Temporal adaptation analysis was not estimable for two valid pooled periods."
  )
}
```

# Objective 4. Vulnerable and stratified analyses

Each valid stratum is analysed under both locked specifications. The figure package includes: (1) cumulative risk-response, (2) exposure-lag contour, (3) 3D exposure-lag-response surface, (4) UTCI effects at the 25th, 75th and 99th percentiles across lags, (5) cold/moderate-heat/extreme-heat lag-response curves, and (6) attributable fraction and attributable deaths when `FluMoDL::attrdl()` is available. Results that cannot be estimated are recorded as NA rather than stopping the report.

```{r stratified-package}
stratified_dir <- "Results/Subgroups/Plots"; dir.create(stratified_dir,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
run_stratified_package <- function(data,label,role,spec,mmt){if(is.null(data)||!is.data.frame(data)||nrow(data)==0||sum(data[[OUTCOME_VAR]]==1,na.rm=TRUE)<20)return(NULL); r<-tryCatch(run_dlnm_spec(data,max_lag=spec$max_lag,exposure_df=spec$exposure_df,lag_df=spec$lag_df,var_knots=spec$var_knots,lag_knots=spec$lag_knots,cen=mmt),error=function(e)NULL); if(is.null(r)||is.null(r$pred))return(NULL); safe<-gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+","_",paste(role,label)); rrfile<-file.path(stratified_dir,paste0(safe,"_RiskResponse.png")); ctfile<-file.path(stratified_dir,paste0(safe,"_Contour.png")); d3file<-file.path(stratified_dir,paste0(safe,"_3D.png")); pctfile<-file.path(stratified_dir,paste0(safe,"_Percentiles.png")); lagfile<-file.path(stratified_dir,paste0(safe,"_LagResponse.png")); png(rrfile,1800,1300,res=200); plot(r$pred,"overall",ci="area",xlab="UTCI (°C)",ylab="Relative Risk",main=paste(role,label,"risk-response"));abline(h=1,lty=2);abline(v=mmt,lty=2);dev.off(); png(ctfile,1800,1500,res=200);plot_contour_surface(r$pred,paste(role,label,"exposure-lag contour"));dev.off(); png(d3file,1800,1500,res=200);plot_3d_surface(r$pred,paste(role,label,"3D exposure-lag-response"));dev.off(); pp<-patchwork::wrap_plots(map2(percentiles,percentile_labels,~create_percentile_plot(r$pred,data[[EXPOSURE_VAR]],.x,.y,paste0(role," "))),ncol=1); ggsave(pctfile,pp,width=8,height=9,dpi=300,bg="white"); png(lagfile,2000,900,res=200);par(mfrow=c(1,3));plot_lag_response(r$pred,mmt-5,"Cold");plot_lag_response(r$pred,mmt+5,"Moderate heat");plot_lag_response(r$pred,mmt+8,"Extreme heat");par(mfrow=c(1,1));dev.off(); afs<-rep(NA_real_,7); names(afs)<-c("AF_total","AF_cold","AF_heat","AF_extreme_cold","AF_moderate_cold","AF_moderate_heat","AF_extreme_heat"); if(flumodl_ok){x<-r$data[[EXPOSURE_VAR]];y<-r$data[[OUTCOME_VAR]];p5x<-quantile(x,.05,na.rm=TRUE);p95x<-quantile(x,.95,na.rm=TRUE);af<-function(z)tryCatch(FluMoDL::attrdl(x,r$cb,y,model=r$fit,type="af",dir="forw",cen=mmt,range=z),error=function(e)NA_real_);afs<-c(AF_total=af(NULL),AF_cold=af(c(-Inf,mmt)),AF_heat=af(c(mmt,Inf)),AF_extreme_cold=af(c(-Inf,p5x)),AF_moderate_cold=af(c(p5x,mmt)),AF_moderate_heat=af(c(mmt,p95x)),AF_extreme_heat=af(c(p95x,Inf)))}; nd<-sum(r$data[[OUTCOME_VAR]]==1,na.rm=TRUE); summary<-tibble(stratum=label,role=role,n_deaths=nd,MMT=r$MMT,QAIC=r$metrics$QAIC,max_RR=r$metrics$max_RR,dispersion=r$metrics$dispersion,kappa=r$metrics$kappa,AF_total_pct=100*afs["AF_total"],AF_cold_pct=100*afs["AF_cold"],AF_heat_pct=100*afs["AF_heat"],attributable_deaths_total=nd*afs["AF_total"],attributable_deaths_cold=nd*afs["AF_cold"],attributable_deaths_heat=nd*afs["AF_heat"]); list(summary=summary,files=c(rrfile,ctfile,d3file,pctfile,lagfile))}
subgroup_specs <- list(); if("sex"%in%names(dat)){subgroup_specs$Sex<-list(Male=dat%>%filter(sex%in%c(1,"1")),Female=dat%>%filter(sex%in%c(2,"2")))}; if("age_at_death"%in%names(dat)){subgroup_specs$Age<-list(`<5 years`=dat%>%filter(age_at_death<5),`5-64 years`=dat%>%filter(age_at_death>=5,age_at_death<65),`65+ years`=dat%>%filter(age_at_death>=65))}; res_var<-intersect(c("residency","residency_status","residence","residence_status","resident_status"),names(dat))[1]; if(length(res_var)&&!is.na(res_var))subgroup_specs$Residency<-split(dat,dat[[res_var]]); if("country"%in%names(dat))subgroup_specs$Country<-split(dat,dat$country); if("climate_zone"%in%names(dat))subgroup_specs$ClimateZone<-split(dat,dat$climate_zone)
run_all_strata <- function(spec,role,mmt){out<-list(); for(nm in names(subgroup_specs)){x<-subgroup_specs[[nm]]; if(is.data.frame(x))out[[nm]]<-run_stratified_package(x,nm,role,spec,mmt) else for(lv in names(x))out[[paste(nm,lv,sep="_")]]<-run_stratified_package(x[[lv]],paste(nm,lv),role,spec,mmt)}; out[!vapply(out,is.null,logical(1))]}
primary_strata <- run_all_strata(best_spec,"Primary",MMT); sensitivity_strata <- run_all_strata(sensitivity_spec,"Sensitivity",sensitivity_MMT)
primary_strata_table<-bind_rows(map(primary_strata,"summary")); sensitivity_strata_table<-bind_rows(map(sensitivity_strata,"summary")); bind_rows(primary_strata_table,sensitivity_strata_table)%>%format_ft(); write_csv(primary_strata_table,"Results/Subgroups/Comprehensive_Stratum_Results_Primary_Lag14_E3L3.csv"); write_csv(sensitivity_strata_table,"Results/Subgroups/Comprehensive_Stratum_Results_Sensitivity_Lag21_E3L3.csv")
strata_manifest<-bind_rows(lapply(names(primary_strata),function(z)tibble(stratum=z,role="Primary",files=length(primary_strata[[z]]$files))),lapply(names(sensitivity_strata),function(z)tibble(stratum=z,role="Sensitivity",files=length(sensitivity_strata[[z]]$files)))); write_csv(strata_manifest,"Results/Subgroups/Stratified_Figure_Manifest.csv")
```
